environment.description: Go service deployed on EC2 instance in a public subnet, fronted by a classic ELB performing TCP passthrough on port 443. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. PostgreSQL 14 on RDS in same VPC with pg_hba.conf trust for the app subnet. No additional middleware or proxy filtering. The application binary runs directly, serving HTTP on port 8080 behind the ELB.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 14, default config, no pg_stat_statements restrictions
config.runtime: EC2 Amazon Linux 2, Go binary, no reverse proxy
